summary: Added test coverage for the memory journal subsystem: new test files for chunking, search/tokenize, multi-chunk store, and extension tool/prompt exposure. Fixed an unterminated-string SyntaxError in tests/pi-extensions/memory-journal.test.ts caused by bash quoting eating a newline escape; all 59 tests then passed under tsc + vitest.
decisions: Used the Edit tool (not Bash node-patch) for the final newline-escape fix in memory-journal.test.ts because bash quoting kept unescaping `\n`
Wiped .gizmo/memory/journal and re-ran `pnpm --filter @gizmo/agent-server backfill` to verify idempotence and file size distribution
errors: SyntaxError: Unterminated string literal at tests/pi-extensions/memory-journal.test.ts:147 — a Bash node-patch and a second Bash attempt both lost the `\n` escape, leaving a real newline inside a single-quoted systemPrompt literal; resolved by editing the file directly to use `\n`
